body.am: በዓመታት ውስጥ ከአዳማ ከተማ፣ ከደረጃዎች ተቋም እና አብረን ከምንሠራቸው ተቋማት የተሰበሰቡ ፈቃዶች፣ ምስክር ወረቀቶች እና ሽልማቶች። ሽልማቶቹን በኩባንያው ወኪልነት መሥራቻችን ተቀብለዋቸዋል።
body.en: Licences, certificates and awards gathered over the years from the city of Adama, the standards institute, and the institutions we work alongside. The awards were received by our founder on the company's behalf.
body.om: Waggoottan darban keessa magaalaa Adaamaa, dhaabbata istaandaardii, akkasumas dhaabbilee waliin hojjennu irraa hayyamoota, ragaawwanii fi badhaasota walitti qabne. Badhaasonni bakka bu'aa dhaabbataatti hundeessaa keenyaan fudhataman.

trainingNote.am: የወፍጮና የጥራት ሠራተኞቻችንም በማጠናከር ውጤታማነትና በሥራ ቦታ ጤናና ደኅንነት ላይ ከውጭ የተሰጡ የሥልጠና ማስረጃዎች አላቸው።
trainingNote.en: Our milling and quality staff also hold external training certificates in fortification efficiency and in workplace health and safety.
trainingNote.om: Hojjettoonni daakuu fi qulqullina keenyaas ragaa leenjii alaa cimsuu bu'a qabeessummaa fi fayyaa fi nageenya iddoo hojii irratti qabu.

image.alt: The full range of Unic biscuits and wafers

text.am: ለአስተማማኝ ምርቶች እና አገር አቀፍ ተደራሽነት ከታመነ ኢትዮጵያዊ አምራች ጋር ይተባበሩ።
text.en: Partner with a trusted Ethiopian manufacturer for reliable products and nationwide reach.
text.om: Oomishaalee amanamaa fi ga'umsa guutuu biyyaatiif oomishaa Itoophiyaa amanamaa waliin hojjedhu.

body.am: አቶ ፍቅሩ ጋረደው ትምህርታቸውን በ12ኛ ክፍል አቁመዋል። ይልቁንም ይዘው የወጡት ካደጉበት ቤት፣ ከአባታቸው የቀዱት ጠንካራ የሥራ ባህል ነው፤ ለደረሱበት ሁሉ አሁንም ምስጋናውን የሚሰጡት ለዚያ ነው።
body.en: Ato Fikru Garedew left school after grade twelve. What he carried instead was the working discipline he grew up with, learned from his father, and it is the thing he still credits for everything that followed.
body.om: Obbo Fikru Garedew barnoota isaanii kutaa 12ffaatti dhaaban. Kanaa mannaa waan qabatanii ba'an amala hojii cimaa mana keessatti guddatan, abbaa isaanii irraa argatan. Waan hunda gaheefis ammallee galata kan kennan isaaf.

body.am: በአዳማ በአንዲት ትንሽ ቦታ በቀን 420 ኩንታል ዱቄት በማምረት ጀመሩ። ዛሬ ይህ አኃዝ 1,920 ደርሷል፤ ያው ፋብሪካም ከአሥራ ሁለት በላይ የUnic ብስኩቶችንና ሙሉ የቅቤ ዌፈር ዓይነቶችን አብሮ ያመርታል። ሁሉንም የጀመረው ዱቄትም አሁንም የብስኩት መስመሮችን ይመግባል።
body.en: He began on a small plot in Adama milling 420 quintals of flour a day. That figure is now 1,920, and the same plant turns out more than a dozen Unic biscuits and a full range of cream wafers alongside it. The flour that started everything still feeds the biscuit lines.
body.om: Adaamaa keessatti lafa xiqqoo irratti guyyaatti daakuu kuntaala 420 oomishuun jalqaban. Har'a lakkoofsi kun 1,920 ga'eera; warshaan sunuma biskuutii Unic kudha lamaa ol fi waafarii kiriimii gosa hunda cinaatti oomisha. Daakuun waan hunda jalqabes ammallee sarara biskuutii sooreessa.

portrait.alt: Ato Fikru Garedew, founder and Chief Executive Officer

image.alt: Combine harvesters bringing in the wheat harvest

text.en: Fikir Food Processing is established on the Adama corridor and enters the wheat flour market.
The Unic brand launches and grows into our flagship consumer product, expanding from plain to apple-vanilla.
Our cream wafer line launches, adding a second branded snack category alongside the biscuits.
We hold our place in flour, biscuits, and wafers while preparing the next production line on land already secured.

mission.am: ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂ በመጠቀም ለደንበኞቻችን የላቀ ጥራት በተመጣጣኝ ዋጋ መስጠት።
mission.en: To supply high-quality food products using modern technology, delivering superior quality at affordable prices.
mission.om: Teeknoolojii ammayyaa fayyadamuun maamiltoota keenyaaf qulqullina olaanaa gatii madaalawaadhaan kennuu.

body.am: የማኅበራዊ አሻራችን የሚጀምረው ከሥራ ዕድል ነው፦ በአዳማ 1,026 የሥራ ዕድሎች፣ ከፋብሪካው ወለል ሥራዎች ውስጥም ጉልህ ድርሻው በሴቶች የተያዘ ነው። ይህ አሁንም በጣም በሚያስፈልግበት አካባቢ መደበኛና ቋሚ ገቢ ማለት ነው።
body.en: Our social footprint starts with employment: 1,026 jobs in Adama, with a large share of our factory floor roles held by women. Formal, steady income in a region where that still matters enormously.
body.om: Miidhaginni hawaasummaa keenyaa hojii irraa jalqaba: Adaamaa keessatti hojii 1,026, hojiiwwan waltajjii warshaa keessaas qooda guddaa dubartootatu qabata. Kun naannoo amma illee baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'e keessatti galii sirrii fi itti fufaa jechuu dha.

meetingCaption.am: የአመራር ኮሚቴው ከዋና ሥራ አስፈጻሚው ጋር
meetingCaption.en: The management committee, with the CEO

quote.am: ወደ ምርት ወለሉ የሚደርስ እያንዳንዱ ውሳኔ አስቀድሞ በዚህ ክፍል ውስጥ ይመከርበታል።
quote.en: Every decision that reaches the production floor is argued out in this room first.
quote.om: Murtiin waltajjii oomishaa bira ga'u hundi dursee kutaa kana keessatti mari'atama.

description.en: Fikir Food Processing: a trusted Ethiopian food manufacturer in Adama for over 15 years, built on quality, honesty, and trust.

vision.am: በኢትዮጵያ እና በአፍሪካ በጥራት እና በጣዕም ግንባር ቀደም የምግብ አምራች መሆን።
vision.en: To be the leading food manufacturer in Ethiopia and Africa, renowned for exceptional quality and taste.
vision.om: Itoophiyaa fi Afrikaa keessatti qulqullinaa fi mi'aan oomishaa nyaataa dursaa ta'uu.

whoWeAreBody.am: ፍቅር ፉድ ፕሮሰሲንግ በ2011 ዓ.ም (እ.ኤ.አ.) በአዳማ የተመሠረተ ሲሆን ስሙን ካማርኛው «ፍቅር» ከሚለው ቃል ወስዷል። አስተማማኝ እና በአገር ውስጥ የሚመረቱ ምርቶች ፍላጎት እያደገ በነበረበት ወቅት ወደ ስንዴ ዱቄት ገበያ ገባን፣ ከዚያን ጊዜ ጀምሮም እየገነባን እንገኛለን።
whoWeAreBody.en: Fikir Food Processing was founded in 2011 in Adama, taking its name from the Amharic word for love. From our base on the Adama corridor we entered the wheat flour market at a time when demand for reliable, locally made staples was accelerating, and we have been building on that ever since.
whoWeAreBody.om: Fikir Food Processing bara 2011 Adaamaatti hundeeffame, maqaa isaas jecha Amaaraa «fikir» jedhu, jaalala jechuu irraa fudhate. Yeroo fedhiin oomishaalee bu'uuraa amanamoo fi biyya keessatti oomishaman dabalaa ture gabaa daakuu qamadii seennee, achii kaasnee ijaaraa jirra.

whoWeAreBody.am: ዛሬ በሕግ የተመዘገበ ኢትዮጵያዊ አምራች ስንሆን ሦስት ደረጃ ያለው የስንዴ ዱቄት፣ ከአሥራ ሁለት በላይ የጣፋጭ ብስኩት ዓይነቶች እና የቅቤ ዌፈር በብሔራዊ እና ዓለም አቀፍ የጥራት ደረጃዎች እናመርታለን፤ የሠራተኞቻችንም ቁጥር 1,026 ደርሷል።
whoWeAreBody.en: Today we are a legally registered Ethiopian manufacturer producing three grades of wheat flour, more than a dozen kinds of sweet biscuit, and a range of cream wafers, all to national and international quality standards, with a workforce of 1,026 people.
whoWeAreBody.om: Har'a oomishaa Itoophiyaa seeraan galmaa'e yoo taanu, daakuu qamadii sadarkaa sadii, biskuutii mi'aawaa gosa kudha lamaa ol, akkasumas waafarii kiriimii ulaagaa qulqullina biyyaalessaa fi addunyaatiin oomishna; baay'inni hojjettoota keenyaas 1,026 ga'eera.

lead.en: Fikir means love. It's how we
lead.om: Fikir jaalala jechuu dha. Akkaataa nyaata ittiin

text.am: Unic ከአሥር ዓመታት በላይ በእያንዳንዱ ጥቅል የመደርደሪያ እውቅናን አትርፏል። ይህን እምነት ማንኛውም አዲስ ገቢ ሊኮርጀው አይችልም።
text.en: Unic has earned its shelf recognition pack by pack over more than a decade. That trust is the hardest thing for any newcomer to copy.
text.om: Unic waggaa kudhan oliif tokkoon tokkoon paakeejiin beekamtii saanqaa argateera. Amantaa kana namni haaraan kamiyyuu hin hiikkatu.

text.am: አብዛኞቹ ተወዳዳሪዎች በዋጋ ወደ ታች ሲሽቀዳደሙ፣ እኛ በጥሬ ዕቃም ሆነ በተጠናቀቀ ምርት ላይ ደረጃችንን እንጠብቃለን።
text.en: Where most competitors race to the bottom on price, we hold the standard on ingredients and finished product.
text.om: Dorgomtoonni hedduun gatiidhaan gadi yeroo dorgoman, nuti meeshaa dheedhii fi oomisha xumurame irratti sadarkaa keenya eegna.

title.am: በዋጋ በሚወዳደር ገበያ ውስጥ በጥራት እንመራለን
title.om: Gabaa gatiin wal dorgomu keessatti qulqullinaan durra deemna

text.am: የብስኩት መስመሮቻችን በራሳችን ዱቄት ይሠራሉ፤ ስለዚህ ጥራትንም ወጪንም ከውስጥ እንቆጣጠራለን።
text.en: Our biscuit lines run on our own flour, so we control quality and cost from the inside instead of hoping a supplier delivers.
text.om: Sararri biskuutii keenyaa daakuu ofii keenyaatiin hojjeta; kanaaf qulqullinaa fi baasii keessaan to'anna.

title.en: We mill the flour we bake with
title.om: Daakuu ittiin tolchinu ofii keenyaa daakna

text.am: የስንዴ ዱቄታችን እስከ ቫይታሚን B12 የተጠናከረ ሲሆን የኢትዮጵያ ደረጃዎች ተቋም ምልክት ይዟል፣ በእያንዳንዱ ምርት የተረጋገጠ።
text.en: Our wheat flour is fortified up to Vitamin B12 and carries the Institute of Ethiopian Standards mark, verified batch by batch.
text.om: Daakuun qamadii keenyaa hanga Vitaaminii B12 cimfamee mallattoo Dhaabbata Istaandaardii Itoophiyaa qaba, tuuta hundaan mirkanaa'a.

text.am: የራሳችን መኪኖች በመላ ኢትዮጵያ ወኪሎችን፣ ጅምላ አከፋፋዮችን እና ቸርቻሪዎችን ይደርሳሉ።
text.en: Our own branded fleet reaches agents, wholesalers, and retailers in every region of the country.
text.om: Konkolaattonni keenya guutuu Itoophiyaatti bakka bu'oota, raabsitootaa fi gurgurtoota bira ga'u.

text.am: ለቀጣዩ የምርት መስመራችን ከፋብሪካው አጠገብ ያለ መሬት ተዘጋጅቷል፤ ስለዚህ እያደገ ያለው ፍላጎት አቅማችንን አይበልጠውም።
text.en: Land next to the plant is already secured for our next production line, so rising demand does not outrun our capacity.
text.om: Sarara oomishaa itti aanuuf lafti warshaa cinaa jiru qophaa'eera; kanaaf fedhiin guddachaa jiru dandeettii keenya hin caalu.

issuer.en: Adama City Administration, Office of the Mayor

text.am: ብር 30,636,554.86 የመንግሥት ገቢ በጊዜው በመክፈልና በዓመቱ ለከተማዋ ልማት ኩባንያው ላደረገው አስተዋጽኦ።
text.en: For paying 30,636,554.86 birr in government revenue on time, and for the part the company played in the city's development that year.
text.om: Galii mootummaa Qarshii 30,636,554.86 yeroon kaffaluu fi gahee dhaabbanni bara sana misooma magaalaatiif bahe.

text.am: በበጀት ዓመቱ የግብር አፈጻጸም የወርቅ ደረጃ።
text.en: Gold tier for tax performance in the budget year.
text.om: Sadarkaa warqee raawwii gibiraa bara baajataa.

text.am: በበጀት ዓመቱ በአዳማ ግንባር ቀደም ግብር ከፋዮች መካከል ተጠቅሷል።
text.en: Named among the leading taxpayers in Adama for the budget year.
text.om: Bara baajataa keessa kaffaltoota gibiraa Adaamaa keessaa adda duree ta'uun caqasame.

issuer.am: የኦሮሚያ ኅብረት ሥራ ባንክ · አቢሲኒያ ባንክ
issuer.en: Cooperative Bank of Oromia · Bank of Abyssinia
issuer.om: Baankii Hojii Gamtaa Oromiyaa · Baankii Abisiiniyaa

text.am: ሁለቱም ባንኮች ለረጅም ጊዜ የሥራ ግንኙነት የእውቅና ምስክር ወረቀት ሰጥተውናል።
text.en: Both banks have given us a certificate of recognition for a long working relationship.
text.om: Baankonni lamaanuu hariiroo hojii yeroo dheeraatiif ragaa beekamtii nuu kennaniiru.

text.am: በኦሮሚያ የማኅበሩን ሥራ የሚደግፍ የድርጅት አባል።
text.en: A corporate member, supporting the Society's work in Oromia.
text.om: Miseensa dhaabbataa, hojii waldaa Oromiyaa keessatti deeggaru.

text.am: ብሔራዊው ጋዜጣ «ስኬታማ የንግድ ሕይወት — ከአባት በተወረሰ ጠንካራ የሥራ ባህል» በሚል ርዕስ ስለ መሥራቻችን ሙሉ ገጽ ዘገባ አቅርቧል።
text.en: The national daily ran a full-page feature on our founder, titled 'A successful business life, built on a work ethic inherited from his father'.
text.om: Gaazexaan biyyaalessaa waa'ee hundeessaa keenyaa gabaasa fuula guutuu baase, mata duree amala hojii cimaa abbaa irraa dhaalame jedhuun.

overviewBody.am: የአዳማ ፋብሪካችን ዓለም ደረጃ ያሉ ከውጭ የመጡ ዘመናዊ ማሽኖችን ይጠቀማል፣ ከመፍጨት እና ከማጠናከር እስከ መጋገር፣ መጥበስ እና ማሸግ። ከጀርባቸው 1,026 ጎበዝ ኢትዮጵያውያን በእያንዳንዱ ፈረቃ ጥራትን ያስገኛሉ።
overviewBody.en: Our Adama plant runs on modern, imported machinery that meets world standards, from milling and fortification to baking, frying, and packing. Behind it stand 1,026 skilled Ethiopians who make quality happen every shift.
overviewBody.om: Warshaan keenya Adaamaa maashinoota ammayyaa sadarkaa addunyaa alaa galan fayyadama — daakuu wixineessuu fi cimsuu irraa hanga tolchuu, waaduu fi qopheessuutti. Duuba isaanii Itoophiyaanonni ogeeyyii 1,026 shiftii hundaan qulqullina fidu.

overviewBody.am: ይህ የቴክኖሎጂ እና የክህሎት ጥምረት በዱቄት፣ በብስኩት፣ በዌፈር እና በቺፕስ ላይ አንድ ደረጃ እንድንይዝ ያስችለናል።
overviewBody.en: That mix of technology and craft is how we hold one standard across flour, biscuits, wafers, and chips.
overviewBody.om: Makaan teeknoolojii fi ogummaa kun daakuu, biskuutii, waafarii fi chiipsii irratti sadarkaa tokko akka qabaannu nu dandeessisa.

text.am: ንጹህ እና ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያለው ስንዴ እና ድንች እናገኛለን፣ ወደ ምርት ከመግባቱ በፊት እያንዳንዱን መግቢያ እንመረምራለን።
text.en: We source clean, high-grade wheat and potatoes, checking every intake before it enters production.
text.om: Qamadii fi dinnicha qulqulluu, sadarkaa olaanaa arganna, gara oomishaatti utuu hin galin dura tokkoo tokkoon qorra.

text.am: ከውጭ የመጡ በዓለም ደረጃ ያሉ ማሽኖች በወጥነት እና በብዛት ይፈጫሉ፣ ይቀላቅላሉ፣ ይጋግራሉ እና ያሽጋሉ።
text.en: Imported, world-standard machinery mills, mixes, bakes, and packs with consistency at volume.
text.om: Maashinoota sadarkaa addunyaa alaa galan wixineessina, makna, tolchina, akkasumas qopheessina.

text.am: የእኛ ላቦራቶሪ እያንዳንዱን ምርት ከመለቀቁ በፊት ከጥራት እና ከማጠናከሪያ መስፈርቶች አንፃር ይፈትናል።
text.en: Our lab tests each batch against quality and fortification targets before it is released.
text.om: Manni qorannoo keenya tuuta hundaa utuu hin gadhiisin dura ulaagaa qulqullinaa fi cimsuu irratti qora.

text.am: እያንዳንዱ ምርት ብሔራዊ እና ዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ ደኅንነት ደረጃዎችን ያሟላል።
text.en: Every product meets national and international food-safety standards, batch after batch.
text.om: Oomishni hundi ulaagaa nageenya nyaataa biyyaalessaa fi addunyaa guuta.

text.am: አከፋፋዮች እና አጋሮች ሁልጊዜ የተከበሩ ናቸው። ጉብኝት ለማዘጋጀት ወይም ትዕዛዝ ለመስጠት ያግኙን።
text.en: Distributors and partners are always welcome. Reach out to arrange a visit or place an order.
text.om: Raabsitoonnii fi michoonni yeroo hunda simatamoo dha. Daawwannaa qindeessuuf yookaan ajaja kennuuf nu qunnamaa.

text.am: ሱቅ ይሁኑ፣ አከፋፋይ ወይም ጥያቄ ያለው ቤተሰብ፣ ከእርስዎ መስማት እንወዳለን።
text.en: Whether you're a shop, a wholesaler, or a family with a question, we'd love to hear from you.
text.om: Suuqii, raabsaa, yookaan maatii gaaffii qabdu taatanis, isin dhaggeeffachuu barbaanna.

body.am: እህል ሲገባ፣ ወፍጮዎች ሲሽከረከሩ፣ ሊጥ ሲቦካ፣ እያንዳንዱ ምርት ሲፈተን፣ መኪኖቻችንም ጎህ ሳይቀድ ሲወጡ። ይህ በአዳማ የተለመደ ቀን ነው።
body.en: Grain arriving, mills turning, dough rising, every batch tested, and a fleet heading out before dawn. This is an ordinary day in Adama.
body.om: Midhaan yeroo galu, daakuun yeroo naanna'u, bukoon yeroo bukamu, tuutni hundi yeroo qoratamu, konkolaattonni keenyas utuu lafti hin bari'in yeroo ba'an. Kun Adaamaa keessatti guyyaa idilee ti.

heroImage.alt: The Fikir plant, fleet and products at sunset

heroSub.am: ከ15 ዓመታት በላይ በአዳማ የተጠናከረ ዱቄት፣ የUnic ብስኩት፣ ዌፈር እና ቺፕስ አምርተን በራሳችን መኪኖች በመላ ኢትዮጵያ ትኩስ እናደርሳለን።
heroSub.en: For over 15 years we've made fortified flour, Unic biscuits, wafers, and chips in Adama, delivered fresh across Ethiopia by our own fleet.
heroSub.om: Waggaa 15 oliif daakuu cimfame, biskuutii Unic, waafarii fi chiipsii Adaamaatti oomishnee, konkolaataa keenyaan guutuu Itoophiyaatti haaraa geessine.

marquee.en: We produce quality, we deliver trust

text.am: ንጹህ፣ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያለው ስንዴ ወደ ምርት ከመግባቱ በፊት ተመርጦ ይመረመራል።
text.en: Clean, high-grade wheat is selected and checked before anything enters production.
text.om: Qamadiin qulqulluu fi sadarkaa ol'aanaa qabu utuu gara oomishaatti hin galin dura filatamee sakatta'ama.

text.am: ዘመናዊ ከውጭ የመጡ ወፍጮዎች ስንዴን ወደ ጥሩና ወጥ ዱቄት ይለውጣሉ፣ እስከ ቫይታሚን B12 በብሔራዊ መስፈርት ተጠናክሮ።
text.en: Modern imported mills turn wheat into fine, consistent flour, fortified up to Vitamin B12 to national standard.
text.om: Daakduun ammayyaa alaa galfaman qamadii gara daakuu qulqulluu fi wal-fakkaatuutti jijjiiru, sadarkaa biyyaalessaatiin hamma Vitaaminii B12'tti cimsamee.

image.alt: Baking at the Fikir plant in Adama

text.am: በተለዩ መስመሮች ላይ የUnic ብስኩቶችንና ዌፈሮችን በየፈረቃው ትኩስ እንጋግራለን።
text.en: On dedicated lines we bake the Unic biscuits and wafers, fresh every shift.
text.om: Sararoota addaa irratti biskuutii fi waafarii Unic yeroo hojii hunda haaraa waadna.

text.am: የውስጥ ላቦራቶሪያችን እያንዳንዱን ምርት ከጥራትና ከማጠናከሪያ ግቦች አንጻር ከመለቀቁ በፊት ይመረምራል።
text.en: Our in-house lab tests every batch against quality and fortification targets before it is released.
text.om: Laabraatooriin keenya inni keessaa oomisha hunda utuu hin gadi-lakkifamin dura galma qulqullinaa fi cimsuu wajjin madaala.

image.alt: Packing at the Fikir plant in Adama

text.am: ምርቶች ታሽገው፣ በሳጥን ተደርገው፣ በመጋዘን ውስጥ ተከምረው ለመላክ ዝግጁ ይሆናሉ።
text.en: Products are sealed, boxed, and stacked in the warehouse, ready to ship.
text.om: Oomishaaleen cufamanii, saanduqaan hidhamanii, mankuusaa keessatti tuulamanii ergamuuf qophaa'u.

text.am: የራሳችን ብራንድ ያላቸው መኪኖቻችን ፍቅርን ወደ ወኪሎች፣ ጅምላ ሻጮችና ሱቆች በኢትዮጵያ ሁሉም ክልሎች ያደርሳሉ።
text.en: Our own branded fleet carries Fikir to agents, wholesalers, and shops across every region of Ethiopia.
text.om: Konkolaattonni keenya maqaa keenya qaban Fikir gara bakka bu'ootaa, daldaltoota gurguddaa fi suuqiiwwan naannoolee Itoophiyaa hundaatti geessu.

description.en: Fikir Food Processing makes fortified flour, Unic biscuits, wafers, and chips in Adama, Ethiopia. Over 15 years, 1,026 employees, delivered nationwide.

title.en: FIKIR FOOD PROCESSING | Flour, Biscuits, Wafers & Chips, Ethiopia

whoWeAreBody.am: በአዳማ የሚገኝ በሕግ የተመዘገበ ኢትዮጵያዊ የምግብ አምራች ነን፤ ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው የስንዴ ዱቄት፣ ከአሥራ ሁለት በላይ የብስኩት ዓይነቶች፣ የቅቤ ዌፈር እና የድንች ቺፕስ *ለመላ አገሪቱ ቤተሰቦች* እናመርታለን።
whoWeAreBody.en: A legally registered Ethiopian food manufacturer in Adama, making the highest-quality wheat flour, more than twelve kinds of biscuits, cream wafers, and potato chips, for *families across the country.*
whoWeAreBody.om: Oomishaa nyaataa Itoophiyaa seeraan galmaa'e kan Adaamaatti argamu, daakuu qamadii sadarkaa olaanaa, biskuutii gosa kudha lamaa ol, waafarii fi chiipsii dhiheessu, *maatii guutuu biyyaatti argamaniif.*

note.am: የዱቄት፣ የብስኩት፣ የዌፈር እና የቺፕስ መስመሮቻችንን በማንቀሳቀስ እና በመከታተል፣ ጥራትን እና ደኅንነትን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ማቆየት።
note.en:
Operate and monitor our flour, biscuit, wafer, and chips lines, keeping quality and safety high.
with 3+years of experience
note.om: Sararoota daakuu, biskuutii, waafarii fi chiipsii hojjachiisuu fi hordofuun, qulqullinaa fi nageenya sadarkaa olaanaatti eeguu.

note.am: የስርጭት አውታራችንን ከወኪሎች፣ ከጅምላ አከፋፋዮች እና ከቸርቻሪዎች ጋር በመላ ኢትዮጵያ ማሳደግ።
note.en: Grow our distribution network with agents, wholesalers, and retailers across Ethiopia.
note.om: Tokkummaa raabsaa keenya bakka bu'oota, raabsitootaa fi gurgurtoota waliin guutuu Itoophiyaatti guddisuu.

note.am: የራሳችንን ብራንድ ያለው መኪና በማንቀሳቀስ ትኩስ ምርቶችን በሰዓቱ ለደንበኞች ማድረስ።
note.en: Operate our own branded fleet, delivering fresh products to customers on time.
note.om: Konkolaataa maqaa keenya qabu oofuun oomishaalee haaraa yeroon maamiltootaaf geessuu.

blurb.am: ለኤክስፖርት ደረጃ የተዘጋጀ የስንዴ ዱቄታችን፣ ለስላሳ እና ወጥ በሆነ መልኩ ተፈጭቶ እስከ ቫይታሚን B12 የተጠናከረ። መጠን ላላቸው ዳቦ ቤቶች አስተማማኝ ውጤት የሚሰጥ ምርጫ።
blurb.en: Our export-grade wheat flour, milled to a fine, consistent standard and fortified up to Vitamin B12. The choice for bakeries that need reliable results at scale.
blurb.om: Daakuu qamadii sadarkaa alergiitti qophaa'e, haphii fi wal fakkaataa ta'ee daakamee hanga Vitaaminii B12'tti cimfame. Warra buddeena baay'inaan tolchaniif filannoo amanamaa.

blurb.am: ለዕለታዊ ጋገራ እና ለእንጀራ የሚያገለግል አስተማማኝ ሁለገብ የስንዴ ዱቄት፣ በብሔራዊ ደረጃ ተጠናክሮ በኢትዮጵያ ቤቶች የታመነ።
blurb.en: A dependable all-purpose wheat flour for everyday baking and injera, fortified to national standards and trusted across Ethiopian kitchens.
blurb.om: Daakuu qamadii hojii hundaaf oolu, tolchuu guyyaa guyyaa fi budeenaaf, sadarkaa biyyaalessaatiin cimfamee mana Itoophiyaa keessatti amanamaa.

blurb.am: በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተመረተ ተመጣጣኝ የስንዴ ዱቄት፣ ተጠናክሮ ለጅምላ አከፋፋዮች፣ ቸርቻሪዎች እና ለብዙ ተጠቃሚ ኩሽናዎች የታሸገ።
blurb.en: Value wheat flour produced to international standard, fortified and packed for wholesalers, retailers, and high-volume kitchens.
blurb.om: Daakuu qamadii gatii madaalawaa sadarkaa addunyaatiin oomishame, cimfamee raabsitootaaf, gurgurtootaa fi mana nyaataa gurguddaaf qopheeffame.

blurb.am: ለባህላዊ እና ለዘመናዊ የምግብ አዘገጃጀት የሚሆን በጥሩ ሁኔታ የተፈጨ የበቆሎ ዱቄት፣ ልክ እንደ ስንዴ ዱቄታችን በዘመናዊ መስመሮች እና በተመሳሳይ የጥራት ደረጃ የተመረተ።
blurb.en: Finely milled corn flour for traditional and modern recipes, produced on the same modern lines and to the same quality standard as our wheat flour.
blurb.om: Daakuu boqqolloo haphii, nyaata aadaa fi ammayyaatiif; sarara ammayyaa fi sadarkaa qulqullina daakuu qamadii keenyaatiin oomishame.

blurb.am: በግሉኮስ የበለጸገ ዋና ብስኩታችን፣ ለዕለታዊ ጉልበት የተጋገረ። አገር አቀፍ ተወዳጅ።
blurb.en: Our flagship glucose-rich biscuit, baked for everyday energy. A national favorite.
blurb.om: Biskuutii giluukoosiin badhaadhe, anniisaa guyyaa guyyaatiif tolfame. Guutuu biyyaatti jaallatamaa.

blurb.am: ለስላሳ በሆነ የቫኒላ ክሬም የተሞሉ ጥርት ያሉ ብስኩቶች።
blurb.en: Crisp biscuits filled with smooth vanilla cream.
blurb.om: Biskuutii cabaa kiriimii vaanilaa lallaafaadhaan guutame.

blurb.am: ብሩህ የአፕል-ቫኒላ ጣዕም ያለው የክሬም ሳንድዊች ብስኩት።
blurb.en: Cream sandwich biscuits with a bright apple-vanilla flavor.
blurb.om: Biskuutii saandwiichii kiriimii mi'aa appilii-vaanilaa ifaa qabu.

blurb.am: ልጆችም ትልልቅ ሰዎችም የሚወዱት የሙዝ ጣዕም ያለው የክሬም ብስኩት።
blurb.en: Banana-flavored cream biscuits that kids and grown-ups reach for.
blurb.om: Biskuutii kiriimii mi'aa muuzii qabu, ijoolleen guddaanis jaallatu.

blurb.am: ጠንካራ የካፑቺኖ ጣዕም ያለው በቡና-ክሬም የተሞላ ብስኩት።
blurb.en: Coffee-cream filled biscuits with a rich cappuccino note.
blurb.om: Biskuutii kiriimii buna qabu, mi'aa kaappuchiinoo cimaa waliin.

blurb.am: ከሻይ ወይም ከወተት ጋር የሚያምር ቀላል፣ ጥርት ያለ የግሉኮስ ብስኩት።
blurb.en: Light, crisp glucose biscuits, perfect with tea or milk.
blurb.om: Biskuutii giluukoosii salphaa fi cabaa, shaayii yookaan aannan waliin mijaa'aa.

blurb.am: በቤተሰብ ሳጥን የሚቀርብ ክብ ሳንድዊች ብስኩት፣ ለምሳ ሳጥን እና ለሻይ ሰዓት ተመራጭ።
blurb.en: Round sandwich biscuits in a family box, a lunchbox and tea-time staple.
blurb.om: Biskuutii saandwiichii geengoo saanduqa maatiitiin dhihaatu, laancii fi yeroo shaayiitiif filatamaa.

blurb.am: ለትንንሽ እጆች እና ለትልቅ ፈገግታ የተሠሩ አስቂኝ የእንስሳት ቅርጽ ያላቸው ብስኩቶች።
blurb.en: Fun animal-shaped biscuits made for little hands and big smiles.
blurb.om: Biskuutii bocaa bineensotaa nama gammachiisu, harka xixiqqaa fi seequu guddaadhaaf.

blurb.am: ቀላል፣ ጥርት ያሉ ጨዋማ ክራከሮች፣ ብቻቸውን ወይም ከቅብ ጋር ለመቅመስ የተዘጋጁ።
blurb.en: Light, crisp savory crackers, made for snacking on their own or with a spread.
blurb.om: Kraakersii salphaa fi cabsaa, kophaatti yookaan waliin nyaachuuf tolu.

blurb.am: በበለጸገ የቸኮሌት ክሬም የተደራረቡ ጥርት ያሉ ዌፈሮች።
blurb.en: Crisp wafers layered with rich chocolate cream.
blurb.om: Waafarii cabaa kiriimii chokoleetii badhaadhaadhaan walitti tuulame.

blurb.am: ለስላሳ በሆነ የቫኒላ ክሬም ያሉ ቀላል ዌፈሮች።
blurb.en: Light wafers with smooth vanilla cream.
blurb.om: Waafarii salphaa kiriimii vaanilaa lallaafaa qabu.

blurb.am: በጣፋጭ የማንጎ ክሬም የተነባበሩ ጥርት ያሉ ዌፈሮች።
blurb.en: Crisp wafers layered with sweet mango cream.
blurb.om: Waafarii cabsaa kiriimii maangoo mi'aawaa qabu.

blurb.am: ጣፋጭ የብርቱካን ክሬም መሙያ ያላቸው ጥርት ያሉ ዌፈሮች።
blurb.en: Crisp wafers with a zesty orange cream filling.
blurb.om: Waafarii cabaa kiriimii burtukaanaa mi'aawaadhaan guutame.

blurb.am: ጣዕም ባለው የቲማቲም ቅመም የተዘጋጀ ጥርት ያለ የድንች ቺፕስ። 100% ተፈጥሯዊ።
blurb.en: Crunchy potato chips with a tangy tomato seasoning. 100% natural.
blurb.om: Chiipsii dinnichaa cabaa qoosaa timaatimii qabu. 100% uumamaa.

blurb.am: ከምርጥ የኢትዮጵያ ድንች የተሠራ ኃይለኛ የፓፕሪካ ቅመም ያለው የድንች ቺፕስ።
blurb.en: Bold paprika-spiced potato chips made from the best Ethiopian potatoes.
blurb.om: Chiipsii dinnichaa qoosaa paaprikaa cimaa qabu, dinnicha Itoophiyaa filatamaa irraa hojjetame.

blurb.am: በቀላሉ የተጨመቀ ጨው ያለው ተፈጥሯዊ የድንች ቺፕስ፣ ኮሌስትሮል የሌለው፣ 100% ተፈጥሯዊ።
blurb.en: Lightly salted natural potato chips, no cholesterol, 100% natural.
blurb.om: Chiipsii dinnichaa uumamaa ashaboo xiqqoo qabu, koolestiroolii hin qabne, 100% uumamaa.

text.am: ምን እንደሚሸጡ እና የት እንዳሉ ይንገሩን። ወደ ቅርብ አቅራቢ እናገናኝዎታለን ወይም እንደ አከፋፋይ እናዘጋጅዎታለን።
text.en: Tell us what you sell and where you are. We'll connect you with the nearest supplier or set you up as a distributor.
text.om: Maal akka gurgurtanii fi eessa akka jirtan nutti himaa. Gara dhiheessaa dhihoo isin qunnamsiifna yookaan raabsaa taasifnee isin qopheessina.

a.am: ዱቄታችን፣ ብስኩታችን፣ ዌፈራችን እና ቺፕሳችን በወኪሎች፣ በጅምላ አከፋፋዮች እና በቸርቻሪዎች በኩል በመላ ኢትዮጵያ ይሰራጫሉ። ያግኙን፣ ወደ ቅርብ አቅራቢ እንመራዎታለን።
a.en: Our flour, biscuits, wafers, and chips are distributed across all regions of Ethiopia through agents, wholesalers, and retailers. Contact us and we'll point you to the nearest supplier.
a.om: Daakuun, biskuutiin, waafariin fi chiipsiin keenya bakka bu'oota, raabsitootaa fi gurgurtoota karaa guutuu Itoophiyaatti raabsamu. Nu qunnamaa, gara dhiheessaa dhihoo isin qajeelchina.

q.en: Where can I buy Fikir products?

a.am: የስርጭት አውታራችንን ሁልጊዜ እያሰፋን ነው። ዝርዝርዎን በአግኙን ቅጹ ይላኩ ወይም ይደውሉልን፣ ቡድናችን ይመልስልዎታል።
a.en: We're always expanding our distribution network. Send us your details through the contact form or call us, and our team will get back to you.
a.om: Yeroo hunda tokkummaa raabsaa keenya bal'isaa jirra. Ragaa keessan karaa unka qunnamtii ergaa yookaan bilbilaa, gareen keenya deebii isiniif kenna.

q.am: እንዴት አከፋፋይ ወይም ወኪል መሆን እችላለሁ?
q.en: How do I become a distributor or agent?
q.om: Akkamittin raabsaa yookaan bakka bu'aa ta'uu danda'a?

a.am: አዎ። የስንዴ ዱቄታችን እስከ ቫይታሚን B12 ተጠናክሮ የኢትዮጵያ ደረጃዎች ተቋም የተጠናከረ የስንዴ ዱቄት ምልክት (CES 309:2024) አለው።
a.en: Yes. Our wheat flour is fortified up to Vitamin B12 and carries the Institute of Ethiopian Standards mark for fortified wheat flour (CES 309:2024).
a.om: Eeyyee. Daakuun qamadii keenyaa hanga Vitaamii B12'tti cimfamee mallattoo daakuu qamadii cimfame kan Inistitiyuutii Istaandaardii Itoophiyaa (CES 309:2024) qaba.

a.am: ስፔሻል ዱቄት በ5፣ 10፣ 25 እና 50 ኪግ ይመጣል፤ 3F እና 1K በ25 እና 50 ኪግ። ብስኩት፣ ዌፈር እና ቺፕስ በነጠላ ማሸጊያ እና በጅምላ ካርቶን ይገኛሉ።
a.en: Special flour comes in 5, 10, 25, and 50 kg; 3F and 1K in 25 and 50 kg. Biscuits, wafers, and chips are available in single packs and wholesale cartons.
a.om: Daakuun Special kg 5, 10, 25 fi 50'n dhufa; 3F fi 1K kg 25 fi 50'n. Biskuutii, waafarii fi chiipsiin paakeejii tokkoo fi kartoonii jumlaan argamu.

q.en: What pack sizes do you offer?

a.am: በአሁኑ ጊዜ የኢትዮጵያን ገበያ በመላ አገሪቱ እናገለግላለን። ወደ ውጭ ገበያዎች መስፋፋት የዕድገት ዕቅዳችን አካል ነው፣ ስለዚህ ለመወያየት ያግኙን።
a.en: We currently serve the Ethiopian market nationwide. Expanding to export markets is part of our growth plan, so please reach out to discuss opportunities.
a.om: Yeroo ammaa gabaa Itoophiyaa guutuu biyyaatti tajaajilla. Gara gabaa biyya alaatti babal'achuun karoora guddina keenyaa keessa jira, kanaafuu mari'achuuf nu qunnamaa.

image.alt: The Unic range held in both hands

description.en: Fortified flour, Unic biscuits, wafers, and chips, made in Adama, Ethiopia and distributed nationwide.

note.am: እስከ ቫይታሚን B12 ተጠናክሮ በብሔራዊ የተጠናከረ ምግብ መርሐ ግብር የተረጋገጠ እና ፈቃድ ያለው።
note.en: Fortified up to Vitamin B12, verified and licensed under the National Fortified Food scheme.
note.om: Hanga Vitaamii B12'tti cimfamee, sagantaa Nyaata Cimfame Biyyaalessaa jalatti mirkanaa'ee hayyama qaba.

note.en: Independently certified in collaboration with the Institute of Ethiopian Standards.

tagline.en: We produce quality; we deliver trust.

taglineAlt.en: Quality you can taste. Consistency you can trust.

quote.am: ለዓመታት የፍቅር ዱቄት እና የUnic ብስኩት አከማችተናል። ጥራቱ ወጥ ነው፣ ደንበኞቻችንም ደጋግመው ይመጣሉ።
quote.en: We've stocked Fikir flour and Unic biscuits for years. The quality is consistent and our customers keep coming back.
quote.om: Waggoota hedduuf daakuu Fikir fi biskuutii Unic kuusaa turre. Qulqullinni isaa wal fakkaataadha, maamiltoonni keenyas irra deddeebi'anii dhufu.

quote.am: ማድረሻዎች በራሳቸው መኪኖች በሰዓቱ ይደርሳሉ፣ የተጠናከረው ዱቄትም ቤተሰቦች የሚጠይቁት ነው።
quote.en: Deliveries arrive on time with their own trucks, and the fortified flour is exactly what families ask for.
quote.om: Geessitoonni konkolaataa isaan2n yeroon ga'u, daakuun cimfames kan maatiin gaafatu dha.

quote.am: የUnic ብስኩት እና ቺፕስ ከመደርደሪያችን በፍጥነት ይሸጣሉ። በተመጣጣኝ ዋጋ የታመነ ኢትዮጵያዊ ብራንድ።
quote.en: Unic biscuits and chips move fast off our shelves. A trusted Ethiopian brand at a fair price.
quote.om: Biskuutii fi chiipsiin Unic daddaffiidhaan gurgurama. Gatii madaalawaadhaan biiraandii Itoophiyaa amanamaa.

text.am: በመጠን እና በዋጋ በሚወዳደር ገበያ ውስጥም እንኳ ጥራት የማይደራደርበት ነው። እያንዳንዱ ምርት ጥብቅ የላቦራቶሪ ምርመራ ካለፈ በኋላ ብቻ ይለቀቃል።
text.en: Quality is non-negotiable, even in a market that competes on volume and cost. Every batch is released only after strict laboratory testing.
text.om: Gabaa baay'inaa fi gatiin wal dorgomu keessattillee qulqullinni waliigaltee hin qabu. Oomishni hundi qorannoo mana qorannoo cimaa booda qofa gadi lakkifama.

text.am: ቅልጥፍናን ለማግኘት ስንል የጥሬ ዕቃዎቻችንንም ሆነ የተጠናቀቀውን ምርት ጥራት አናበላሽም።
text.en: We do not compromise the integrity of our ingredients or the finished product in pursuit of efficiency.
text.om: Saffisa argachuuf jecha qulqullina meeshaa dheedhii keenyaa yookaan oomisha xumurame hin miidhnu.

text.am: ብክነትን በመቀነስ፣ ክህሎትን በማሳደግ እና ሂደቶቻችንን በማዘመን ዓመት በዓመት እንሻሻላለን።
text.en: We improve continuously, reducing waste, upgrading skills, and modernising our processes year after year.
text.om: Balleessaa hir'isuun, dandeettii guddisuun fi adeemsa keenya ammayyeessuun waggaa waggaan ni fooyyofna.

text.am: ተመሳሳይ ጣዕም እና ተመሳሳይ ደረጃ በእያንዳንዱ ምርት በማቅረብ የደንበኞቻችንን ታማኝነት እናገኛለን።
text.en: We earn loyalty by delivering the same taste and the same standard, batch after batch.
text.om: Mi'aa wal fakkaataa fi sadarkaa wal fakkaataa tuuta hundaan dhiheessuun amanamummaa maamiltootaa arganna.

text.am: የሥራ ዕድል በሚፈጥር፣ ሴቶችን በሚያበረታታ እና የኢትዮጵያን የምግብ ዋስትና በሚያጠናክር መንገድ እናድጋለን።
text.en: We grow in ways that create jobs, empower women, and strengthen Ethiopia's food security.
text.om: Karaa hojii uumu, dubartoota jajjabeessuu fi nageenya nyaataa Itoophiyaa cimsuun ni guddanna.

text.am: ከሚለዋወጠው የሸማቾች ጣዕም ቀድመን ለመገኘት በምርቶች፣ በጣዕሞች እና በሂደቶች ላይ እንፈጥራለን።
text.en: We innovate in products, flavours, and processes to stay ahead of changing tastes.
text.om: Mi'aa maamiltootaa jijjiiramaa jiru dursuuf oomishaalee, mi'aa fi adeemsa irratti ni kalaqna.
